from __future__ import annotations

import typing

import pytest

from llm_router import Model, Provider
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import ProviderCredential, ProviderRequest
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


def _request(
    messages: list[typing.Any] | None = None,
) -> ProviderRequest:
    value = "neutral-credential-value"
    return ProviderRequest(
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWEN_PLUS,
        provider_model="qwen-plus",
        messages=messages or [],
        credential=ProviderCredential(value=value),
        temperature=None,
        seed=None,
        tool_registry=None,
        tool_choice=None,
        kwargs={},
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_qwenchat_abuild_payload_disables_streaming() -> None:
    request = _request(messages=[normalize_content("Hello")])
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:1/api")

    payload = await adapter.abuild_payload(request)

    assert payload["stream"] is False
    assert payload["model"] == request.provider_model
